excerpt: Fitting the partial decay branching fraction as a function of w and using the average of lattice QCD calculations of the B to D form factor, we obtain |Vcb| = (39.2 +/- 0.4 (stat.) +/- 0.6 (sys.) +/- 0.5 (th.)) x 10^-3.
publisher: Belle II Collaboration / Phys. Rev. D 112, 112009 (2025)
title: Determination of |Vcb| using B to D l nu_l Decays at Belle II
